name: turning: the flange in the front view, free rotation (the default)
eval:
(async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const V = () => m.viewport; const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]; const ang = (a, b) => Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot(a, b)))) * 180 / Math.PI; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('flange'); await sleep(1200); m.actions.updateSettings({ orbitMode: 'free' }); await m.run('view:front'); await sleep(900); const r = V().canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__c = [r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2];
     const c = V().cameraState(); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.settings.orbitMode, front: ang(c.dir, [0, -1, 0]) < 0.5 && ang(c.up, [0, 0, 1]) < 0.5 }); })()
